title: Correct linear velocity
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be v₀ = ω₀r.

title: Correct centripetal force
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be f = mω₀²r.

title: Applies centripetal force relation
description: Important: The solution correctly identifies that the static friction provides the centripetal force for circular motion.

title: Uses velocity-angular velocity relation
description: Important: The solution correctly uses the kinematic relation v = ωr for uniform circular motion.

title: Identifies force direction
description: Optional: The solution notes that the frictional force is directed radially inward toward the center of the plate.

title: Incorrect centripetal force formula
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect formula for centripetal force, such as mωr or mv/r, instead of mω²r or mv²/r.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Providing a final answer with incorrect units or a missing variable (e.g., omitting mass m or radius r).
